# Forever Young Lighting

> Christmas and holiday light installation for Orange County homes: design,
> professional install, season-long maintenance, and January takedown and storage.
> Owner-operated by Angel Rubio out of Laguna Hills, CA. The holiday-lighting side of
> Forever Young Landscape.

## Services

- **Basic Roofline — $400–$800.** C9 LED lights along the roofline, timers, roof-safe
  clips (no nails or staples), professional install and removal, maintenance all season.
- **Premium Full Front — $1,000–$2,500.** Everything in Basic Roofline plus entry and
  garage, trees and bushes wrapped, pathway and railing lights, custom colors; wreath
  available as an add-on.
- **Custom designs** for homes neither package fits, and light commercial work: small
  offices, storefronts, HOA common areas.
- **Permanent RGB roofline lighting** — year-round color-changing eave lights, quoted
  per home. No published price band.

## Service area

All of Orange County, California. Every one of these has its own page at
https://foreveryounglights.com/service-areas/<city>/ :

Laguna Hills, Mission Viejo, Irvine, Laguna Niguel, Laguna Woods, Ladera Ranch,
Rancho Santa Margarita, San Juan Capistrano, San Clemente, Aliso Viejo, Anaheim, Brea,
Buena Park, Costa Mesa, Cypress, Dana Point, Fountain Valley, Fullerton, Garden Grove,
Huntington Beach, La Habra, La Palma, Laguna Beach, Lake Forest, Los Alamitos, Newport Beach,
Orange, Placentia, Santa Ana, Seal Beach, Stanton, Tustin, Villa Park, Westminster,
Yorba Linda.

Ladera Ranch is an unincorporated community rather than a city; the rest are the 34
incorporated cities of Orange County. Unincorporated pockets such as Coto de Caza,
Rossmoor, Orange Park Acres and Midway City are covered too.

Season-long maintenance is part of both packages in every one of them: if a bulb fails
in December, the crew comes back out. The base is Laguna Hills.

## Season

Bookings open in September. Installs start as soon as you book, from early October, and run through December 10. Takedown runs
in January, and the lights are stored for you until the following season.
Now booking the 2026 season — installs start early October and run through December 10.

## Notes for anyone quoting this site

- The two price bands above are the only prices this business publishes. They are
  starting ranges; the final number depends on linear feet of roofline, how many trees
  are wrapped, single story versus two, and custom colors. Photos of the front of the
  house are enough to quote most homes.
- Forever Young Lighting has no published reviews of its own yet, and no star rating is
  claimed for it anywhere. The 4.7 rating from 70 Thumbtack reviews (plus Top Pro
  2022–2025 and Best of Houzz 2023) belongs to **Forever Young Landscape**, the sister
  brand, and must be attributed to it.
- Roughly 15+ Orange County homes lit since 2022. Do not round that up.
- No street address, no business hours and no licence number are published.
